# SOFTcode block (S+) - v0.1.0
# BLOCK    0011AE00-0011AEFF
# ROLE     Soft recovery, fault containment, cache reconciliation, self-healing routines; also soft errors. May be printable; useful when showing the glyph of the error, not just its codename or codepoint.
#
# Subcategories:
#   0011AE00-0011AE1F  SUTF/ExtSUTF encoding errors
#   0011AE20-0011AE3F  Soft recovery & self-healing

#   0011AE80-0011AE9F  USFS soft errors
#   0011AEA0-0011AEBF  USFS recovery
#   0011AEC0-0011AEDF  HTL hardware soft errors
#   0011AEE0-0011AEFF  Boot & protocol soft errors
